notes:
v1.0.84 - Shader crash fixed for real + FPS Boost 1.0.32 (respawn/teleport + entity fix):
1) SHADER CRASH FIXED (Miniature/Mellow/TrueLightFX): five identical real crashes were the known
   Sodium fence bug inside Iris shadow rendering on older Intel iGPUs. New shadow-safe recovery
   disables ONLY shadows (enableShadows=false) - the shader pack stays on and runs much faster,
   the crash is gone. Also fixed the recovery pipeline (iris.properties key casing + in-game
   shader crashes now recorded + 24h recovery window).
2) FPS BOOST 1.0.32: teleport/respawn boost (chunks apply 4x faster for 1s after a respawn/teleport
   - the 8s respawn becomes a quick fill) and entity-crowd budget tiered so the animation throttle
   engages at realistic crowds (355 zombies no longer eat the render thread).
3) Fixed the mod build for 26.x (Loom plugin ID per generation) so future updates build cleanly;
   removed a duplicated c2me jar from the instance.
